items.name: Noodles Twistara
items.subtitle: With Spicy Sauce
items.description: Wok-seared delicate noodles tossed with vibrant bell peppers, scallions, and chili flakes in chef's special fiery sweet-soy reduction.
items.fullDescription: Artisanal hand-pulled noodles flash-fried in a roaring wok with seasonal sweet peppers, garlic chives, fresh cilantro, and our signature fiery chili sauce. Topped with toasted sesame seeds and fresh lime.

items.name: Pizza Sicilia
items.subtitle: Pizza Sicilia
items.description: Authentic stone-baked crispy crust loaded with rich tomato sugo, aged mozzarella, artisanal pepperoni, and aromatic fresh oregano.
items.fullDescription: Wood-fired sourdough crust baked at 450°C, layered with San Marzano tomato purée, buffalo mozzarella, crispy pepperoni cups, fresh basil leaves, and cold-pressed Sicilian olive oil.

items.name: Burger Classic
items.subtitle: Melted Cheddar & Beef
items.description: Juicy grilled Angus beef patty topped with gooey melted Wisconsin cheddar, crisp lettuce, ripe tomato, and house burger relish.
items.fullDescription: Char-grilled 100% prime Angus beef patty glazed with melted sharp cheddar, served on a toasted brioche bun with crispy butterhead lettuce, vine tomato slice, red onion slivers, and secret burger sauce.

items.name: Skewers Tikka
items.subtitle: Charcoal Grilled
items.description: Tender marinated meat and vegetables skewered and char-grilled over open coals with aromatic herbs.
items.fullDescription: Skewers of prime tender meat alternate with sweet bell peppers and red onions, basted in spiced garlic-herb butter and cooked to smoky perfection over open charcoal flames.

items.name: Crispy Nachos & Chips
items.subtitle: Golden Corn Seasoned
items.description: Crunchy artisanal corn tortilla chips tossed in smoked paprika and sea salt, served with herb dip.
items.fullDescription: Stone-ground golden corn chips kettle-cooked to ultra-crisp perfection, seasoned with smoked sea salt, oregano, and mild chili, paired with fresh house-made guacamole and tangy salsa.

items.name: Truffle Fries
items.subtitle: Rosemary & Parmesan
items.description: Hand-cut golden fries drizzled with white truffle oil and fresh grated Parmigiano-Reggiano.
items.fullDescription: Crisp Belgian-style fries tossed with aromatic white truffle essence, sea salt flakes, freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano, and chopped wild rosemary.

items.name: Iced Citrus Mocktail
items.subtitle: Fresh Mint & Lime
items.description: Chilled sparkling lemonade with crushed ice, muddled garden mint, and a fresh lime wheel garnish.
items.fullDescription: Crisp and invigorating sparkling citrus cooler crafted with fresh-squeezed Key limes, organic cane syrup, and fragrant crushed mint leaves over crystalline ice.

items.name: Summer Fruit Medley
items.subtitle: Seasonal Sweet Harvest
items.description: Sun-ripened fresh fruit selection with sweet oranges, ripe strawberries, and crisp grapes.
items.fullDescription: A refreshing basket of hand-picked seasonal fruits: sweet Valencia oranges, fresh California strawberries, and chilled crisp seedless grapes, served with a honey-lime glaze.
